en.title: Text Animation and Kinetic Typography Examples
en.description: Fourteen text animation recipes from launch films: kinetic typography, typing, text behind an object, blur text, count up and more. Built with HyperFrames.
en.h1: Text animation examples from launch films
en.lede: Text animation moves words and letters on screen to carry a message in a launch film. These fourteen recipes cover kinetic typography, typing animation, the typewriter effect, word-by-word highlight, text that interacts with objects, text behind an object, folded 3D ribbons, scrolling text, one word per cut, blur text, a Star Wars style text crawl and count-up numbers. Each film runs 10 to 12 seconds at 1920x1080, is built in code with HyperFrames and is shown next to the original clip, with timing per word, letter and character.

blocks.text: How text animation is used in a launch film

Launch films use text for spec lines, taglines and the closing wordmark. Kinetic Typography shows four sentences of 2.05 s each and ends on a wordmark card from 8.3 s. Word-by-Word Text Highlight lights a 37-word paragraph over 5.92 s, then cuts to the wordmark card at 8.3 s. In both recipes the text is the main content of the frame.

Typing animation, also called the typewriter effect, appears when a film shows a command, a prompt or a search. Typing at an uneven speed with a typo and a delete reads as a person at a keyboard, and the Prompt Carousel puts the same typing inside an input box. For the type that forms a logo, see [logo animation](/logo-animation/); for text inside interface shots, see [UI animation](/ui-animation/).

Four more recipes build the shot around the text. Text Behind Object Effect puts a giant headline behind an app window, and the headline changes word by word while the window holds still. 3D Ribbon Text Animation folds a two-line title into zig-zag ribbons, multiplies them into rows and wipes to the product interface. Scrolling Text Animation scrolls a long line sideways faster and faster, then squeezes it into one short chat bubble. One Word per Cut lands a sentence one word per cut, each word centered over a different product screen.

Three more recipes animate text through focus, depth and counting. Blur Text Animation brings large words on black into focus one by one, blurs a line away word by word as the next arrives, and ends with the tagline resolving over the product mark. Star Wars Style Text Crawl is a Star Wars style crawl: a block of text recedes up a tilted plane over a starfield, then the stars rise and a lockup appears. Count Up Animation rolls a huge number up digit by digit, fast at first and slowing onto its target, then repeats the move in a dashboard card with a line drawing in step.
The 14 text animation recipes

items: [Kinetic Typography](/recipes/kinetic-typography/): A spec line is split into words on uneven baselines, a connector word steps up letter by letter, and each 2.05 s sentence hard-cuts to the next.

[Typing Animation (Typewriter Effect)](/recipes/typing-animation/): Monospace text is typed at uneven human speed with a cursor, including a typo, five backspaces and a retype, then 32 characters are deleted in 0.7 s.
[Word-by-Word Text Highlight](/recipes/word-by-word-text-highlight/): Words in a small centered paragraph brighten from gray to white one at a time over 5.92 s, and the text never moves.
[Logo Wordmark Reveal](/recipes/logo-wordmark-reveal/): The wordmark unfolds from behind the mark in 1.3 s, each letter sharpening from a 12 px blur, 0.08 s apart.

[Chromatic Aberration Text Effect](/recipes/chromatic-aberration-text-effect/): Headline letters stretch horizontally with RGB ghosting for 0.17 to 0.3 s, step down through 2-frame states and snap back clean.
[Prompt Carousel](/recipes/prompt-carousel/): A line under the headline thickens into a pill and then an input box, types a 41-character prompt in 2.7 s, and scrolls through prompts every 0.85 s.

[Text–Object Interleave](/recipes/text-object-interleave/): Type and object interleave in depth: the wordmark rises from behind the product over 1.8 s, a word passes through an object and comes out as another, and a device slots into a sentence.
[Text Behind Object Effect](/recipes/text-behind-object-effect/): A giant headline sits behind an app window and changes word by word while the window holds still.
[3D Ribbon Text Animation](/recipes/3d-ribbon-text-animation/): A two-line title folds into zig-zag 3D ribbons and multiplies into rows, then arrow bands sweep past and wipe to the product interface.
[Scrolling Text Animation](/recipes/scrolling-text-animation/): A long run-on line scrolls sideways faster and faster, then squeezes into one short chat bubble.
[One Word per Cut](/recipes/one-word-per-cut/): A sentence lands one word per cut, each word centered over a different product screen.

[Blur Text Animation](/recipes/blur-text-animation/): Large words on black come into focus one by one, a line blurs away word by word as the next arrives, and the tagline resolves over the product mark.

[Star Wars Style Text Crawl](/recipes/star-wars-text-crawl/): A Star Wars style crawl: a block of text with a kicker and a title recedes up a tilted plane over a starfield, then the stars rise and a lockup appears.

[Count Up Animation](/recipes/count-up-animation/): A huge number rolls up digit by digit, fast at first and slowing onto its target, then the same move runs in a dashboard card with a line drawing in step.

blocks.text: How to make these with Claude Code or Codex
Install the Motionboard skill in Claude Code or Codex. Then paste the copy prompt from a recipe page, or ask the skill for a recipe by name and give it your product, logo and brand colors.
npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard

The agent recreates the shot for your own product. Copy one recipe, or ask the skill for a whole film built from several. The output is an MP4 rendered with HyperFrames, or GSAP motion that runs on your website. The [product launch video guide](/guides/product-launch-video-with-claude-code/) covers the full workflow.

items: What is kinetic typography?

Kinetic typography is text animated as the main visual. In the Kinetic Typography recipe, a spec line is split into single words placed far apart on uneven baselines, a connector word steps up letter by letter, and roman and italic type are mixed. Each sentence holds about 1 to 1.3 s before a hard cut.
How fast should a typing animation or typewriter effect be?

The Prompt Carousel types 41 characters in 2.72 s, about 15 characters per second. The Typing Animation recipe varies the speed by character and includes a typo and a delete: 32 characters are removed in 0.7 s. Uneven speed reads as human typing.
How long should text stay on screen?

In these recipes a finished sentence holds for roughly 1 to 2 s. Kinetic Typography gives each spec sentence 2.05 s in total, and Word-by-Word Text Highlight holds the complete 37-word paragraph for about 1.96 s before the cut.

zh.title: 文字动画与动态文字排版示例
zh.description: 14 个来自发布片的文字动画配方，包括动态文字排版、打字动画、文字在物体后面、模糊文字、数字滚动等，用 HyperFrames 写代码做出，并与原片对照。
zh.h1: 发布片里的文字动画示例
zh.lede: 文字动画让文字和字母在画面上运动，用来传达发布片里的信息。这 14 个配方覆盖动态文字排版（kinetic typography）、打字动画、打字机效果、逐词高亮、文字与物体的互动、文字在物体后面、3D 折带文字、滚动文字、一词一切、模糊文字、星战风格字幕滚动和数字滚动。每个都是用 HyperFrames 写代码做出的 10 到 12 秒 1920x1080 短片，旁边附上原片，并标出每个词、字母和字符的时间。

blocks.text: 发布片怎么用文字动画
发布片把文字用在参数句、标语和结尾字标上。动态文字排版配方有四句话，每句 2.05 秒，从 8.3 秒起进入字标卡。逐词文字高亮用 5.92 秒点亮一段 37 个词的文字，在 8.3 秒切到字标卡。这两个配方里，文字都是画面的主要内容。
片子里出现命令、提示词或搜索时，会用到打字动画，也就是打字机效果。带打错和删除的不均匀速度打字像有人在键盘前操作，提示词轮播把同样的打字放进输入框里。构成 logo 的文字见 [Logo 动画](/logo-animation/)，界面镜头里的文字见 [UI 动画](/ui-animation/)。
另有四个配方围绕文字来搭镜头。文字在物体后面效果把巨大的标题放在应用窗口后面，窗口保持不动，标题逐词替换。3D 折带文字动画把两行标题折成锯齿状的折带，增殖成多排，再擦除切到产品界面。滚动文字动画让一条长句子横向越滚越快，最后压缩成一个简短的聊天气泡。一词一切文字动画让一句话每次切镜出现一个词，每个词都居中叠在不同的产品界面上。
另有三个配方用对焦、纵深和计数来做文字动画。模糊文字动画让黑场上的大字逐词从模糊里变清楚，一行文字逐词虚化散去，下一行接着出现，最后标语在产品标志上方变清楚。星战风格字幕滚动是星战风格的字幕滚动：一块文字沿倾斜平面在星空上向远处退去，字幕滚完后星星上升，出现标识。数字滚动动画让一个很大的数字一位一位向上滚，开头很快，最后慢慢落在目标数上，随后同一个手法出现在仪表盘卡片里，折线随数字同步画出。
14 个文字动画配方

items: [动态文字排版](/recipes/kinetic-typography/)：参数句拆成单词，落在高低不齐的基线上，连接词的字母逐个错开，每句 2.05 秒后硬切到下一句。
[打字机动画](/recipes/typing-animation/)：等宽字配光标，以不均匀的人手速度打字，包括一次打错、五次退格和重打，之后 0.7 秒内删掉 32 个字符。
[逐词高亮动画](/recipes/word-by-word-text-highlight/)：居中小段文字里的词在 5.92 秒内逐个由灰变白，文字本身不位移。
[Logo 字标展开动画](/recipes/logo-wordmark-reveal/)：字标在 1.3 秒内从符号背后展开，每个字母从 12px 模糊变清晰，间隔 0.08 秒。
[色散文字效果](/recipes/chromatic-aberration-text-effect/)：标题字母横向拉长并带 RGB 重影，持续 0.17 到 0.3 秒，经 2 帧一级的状态逐级回正。
[输入框提示词轮播](/recipes/prompt-carousel/)：标题下的一条线加厚成胶囊再变成输入框，2.7 秒内打出 41 个字符的提示词，之后约每 0.85 秒滚动到下一条。
[文字穿插实物效果](/recipes/text-object-interleave/)：文字和实物在深度上互相穿插：字标在 1.8 秒内从产品后面升起，一个词穿过物体后变成另一个词，设备被插入句子中间。
[文字在物体后面效果](/recipes/text-behind-object-effect/)：巨大的标题位于应用窗口后面，窗口保持不动，标题逐词替换。
[3D 折带文字动画](/recipes/3d-ribbon-text-animation/)：两行标题折成锯齿状的 3D 折带并增殖成多排，随后箭头色带扫过，擦除切到产品界面。
[滚动文字动画](/recipes/scrolling-text-animation/)：一条很长的连写句子横向越滚越快，最后压缩成一个简短的聊天气泡。
[一词一切文字动画](/recipes/one-word-per-cut/)：一句话每次切镜出现一个词，每个词都居中叠在不同的产品界面上。
[模糊文字动画](/recipes/blur-text-animation/)：黑场上的大字逐词从模糊里变清楚，一行文字逐词虚化散去，下一行接着出现，最后标语在产品标志上方变清楚。
[星战风格字幕滚动](/recipes/star-wars-text-crawl/)：星战风格的字幕滚动：带小标和标题的一块文字沿倾斜平面在星空上向远处退去，字幕滚完后星星上升，出现标识。
[数字滚动动画](/recipes/count-up-animation/)：一个很大的数字一位一位向上滚，开头很快，最后慢慢落在目标数上，随后同一个手法出现在仪表盘卡片里，折线随数字同步画出。

blocks.text: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做出这些效果
在 Claude Code 或 Codex 里安装 Motionboard skill。之后可以粘贴配方页上的复制提示词，也可以直接按名字向 skill 要一个配方，并提供你的产品、logo 和品牌色。
npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard
Agent 会按你的产品重新做出这个镜头。可以只复制一个配方，也可以让 skill 用多个配方拼成一整支片子。输出是用 HyperFrames 渲染的 MP4，或者可以直接放进网站的 GSAP 动效。完整流程见[产品发布视频指南](/guides/product-launch-video-with-claude-code/)。

items: 什么是动态文字排版（kinetic typography）？
动态文字排版指把文字动画本身作为主要画面。动态文字排版配方把参数句拆成单词，放在拉开的高低不齐的基线上，连接词的字母逐个错开，并混排正体和斜体。每句停留约 1 到 1.3 秒后硬切。
打字动画或打字机效果应该多快？
提示词轮播在 2.72 秒内打出 41 个字符，约每秒 15 个字符。打字动画配方让每个字符的速度不均匀，还包含一次打错和删除：32 个字符在 0.7 秒内删完。速度不均匀会让人觉得是真人在打字。
文字应该在画面上停留多久？
这些配方里，一句完整的文字大约停留 1 到 2 秒。动态文字排版每句参数句共 2.05 秒，逐词文字高亮在 37 个词全部点亮后再停留约 1.96 秒才切走。
